# Processing: upstream course materials

These are four **actual upstream teaching notebooks**, separate from the original lessons in `notebooks/01_processing`. Their licenses permit redistribution. They are supplied for reading and for use within their documented upstream environments. They have **not** been executed by this course's validation runner.

Exact complete commit IDs, upstream paths, SHA-256 checksums and license declaration URLs are in [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json). Source and local hashes match: these four files are **byte-for-byte unchanged**, apart from the renamed local DartBrains filename. The three Jupyter files already contain no saved execution outputs, attachments or embedded image data. No image datasets, model weights or upstream figures were downloaded into this directory. Linked figures/assets remain upstream and may not render from this partial local copy.

The Nipype examples expect the tutorial's own environment, auxiliary helpers, BIDS data and, for preprocessing, external FSL/FreeSurfer commands. Some cells download substantial datasets or run external processes. Read them before executing. Their paths and API versions may require the pinned repository's environment. See [the upstream setup](https://github.com/nipy/nipype_tutorial/tree/f11c9c7b8e7a1983918f1d517ec9cf3dfcb78236).

The DartBrains file is a **Marimo `.py` notebook**, not a Jupyter notebook. Its own metadata declares Python >=3.11 and `dartbrains-tools>=0.3.1`; it uses Marimo, plotting packages, course utilities and assets from the upstream course. Open the [published chapter](https://dartbrains.org/Preprocessing/) for the complete learning environment. The embedded upstream grader configuration is part of the unmodified source; our course does not submit to that service or claim those grading results.

The CC BY-SA license applies to the DartBrains material. If you adapt and redistribute that chapter, preserve attribution, indicate your modifications and follow its ShareAlike terms. The BSD license applies to the Nipype material. Neither source endorses this course. Public FSL and FreeSurfer pages, and other documentation listed in the [coverage ledger](../../curriculum/processing_coverage.md), are linked rather than mirrored. Public access by itself does not establish a right to redistribute their text, figures or datasets.
